name: Maelibus
description: The Maelibi (singular Maelibus), native to the planet of Iego, were known as Demons by those beings who had visited the planet. They were less well-known than the Diathim, primarily because the Maelibi lived below ground near the core, and rarely left the planet itself.

data.name: Maelibus
data.distinctions: Horns, claws, sharp teeth, metal skin, and hypnotic singing abilities
